comment.body:
This is called "codependence".

Every codependent relationship is a micro-cult. 

No codependence? Cults would be impossible. 

You're not actually living as long as you're stuck in codependence. The way you know it's codependence is that you feel stuck.

Living real life does not feel like being stuck.

You have no obligation to another human being, nor to all other human beings. Only codependents obligate each other.

Most of you probably can't even imagine what that would be like. 

There is a shitload of good things we can do for each other. Not one of them is obligatory. Obligation is a lie foisted on you -- not by people who care about you, but by people that want to use and abuse and take advantage of you. 

It's certainly got nothing at all to do with love.

comment.name: Millard J Melnyk
comment.body:
I absolutely disagree on this one.

Killing their young has been the HALLMARK of every single society that has ever been called "civilized", not the opposite of what made them civilized.

In fact, the threat of killing its own is the critical factor that the process of "civilizing" hinges on.

Every single civilization we know of operated on the key operating principle of extortion: extracting behavior against one's will, motivating this self-violation by the threat of death to what we love.

Civilized economics operate on this death threat by defining "ownership" as preemptory deprivation. Civilized legal systems are nothing but the crass threat of death to what we love to extort approved behavior from us.

Historically and incontrovertibly, (as long as you stick to facts and evidence and keep out bullshit rationalizations,) civilizations are death cults. Not only has every single civilization been a death cult, the design principles in the structure and essential operating patterns that make them "civilized" are all based on death to our beloved. In fact, acceptance, normalization, and elevation of death to the beloved into a defining virtue are none other than the metrics that measure a society's degree of civilization.

The epitome of the civilized person is the one who makes the "ultimate sacrifice". The essence of civilization, its very spirit, is death to love itself.

comment.body:
https://sashalatypova.substack.com/p/on-shannon-joy-show-december-5

Lots of people have told me that there is "no evidence" of the "conspiracy theory" that the primary purpose for the mRNA shots was and still is to harm people.

Well, yeah, that's kinda just what happens when your head has been firmly stuck up the ass of the mainstream echo chamber.

At this point in time, anyone and everyone who does not know the facts that Sasha has so meticulously catalogued over the last 2-1/2 years is obstinately ignorant. That means you would have pulled your head out of the propaganda shitpile by now if you had sincerely wanted to know what's really going on and hadn't steadfastly refused, at every turn, to look where the data was readily available.

That's on you.

At some point "I've seen no proof" flips from being a statement on a lack of evidence and becomes a self-accusation of pig-headed dumbshittery -- but, in keeping with the cluelessness of the attitude, the pig-headedly dumbshit have no inkling what they're actually broadcasting.

We SUSPECTED what was going on right off the bat. I KNEW something was coming since Spring 2019 with the measles scare. By February/March of 2020, WE SAW what was going on.

People like you were partly right, at first: we didn't have enough data to prove it -- but we had PLENTY ENOUGH DATA TO KNOW IT.

You were so smug and arrogant then. Sucked to be you.

Now, you've heard people tell you these thing for almost 5 years. FIVE YEARS. That's plenty long enough for any honest person to get a clue... if they wanted to.

The only question now is whether you'll extract yourself from the propaganda anus.

For those who are committed to keeping their heads stuck up there while they wade in the mammoth piles of bullshit that have been required to pull this off:

Sucks to be you.

“I've pointed to the contracts, to the DOD contracts, how they were ordered, funded through the Operation Warp Speed. And I said, clearly, this shows that these are weapons. These are not medicines.”

Think how many people are in the world.

Think about how many of them you’ll get to know. How many you’ll even get to meet.

Then think how many people in the world you love.

And how many people that you’ll meet from here on out that you’ll love.

And how many of them do you plan to offer love when you first meet them?

How many do you plan to offer respect when you first meet them?

Contemplating those questions will lead you to see what I’m talking about.

comment.body:
Watch this TWICE (at least).

Let it sink in.

THIS IS JUST ONE EXAMPLE of how magnificently wrong you've gone because you believe whatever comes out of the mouths of your favorite talking heads -- and that includes every single fucking "world leader" -- when they lie through their teeth.

And you can tell when they're lying, because their lips start moving.

"But Millard -- that would apply to the guys in the video, too! So, you're left with nuthin! "

Sure, that's the dumb way to look at it, because if everyone's lying, why listen to anyone -- including your favorite talking heads -- and why even vote?

But you do listen, and many of you do vote. So, don't try stuffing that horseshit logic down my throat, cuz it certainly didn't come up from me.

What we're actually left with are questions that can be answered IF WE ARE RATIONAL ABOUT IT.

Any of us can figure this shit out. But that IS NOT the problem.

The problem is that you do not want to figure it out. You'd rather play the victim of ignorance, "It's too complicated!" and pretend you'll be OK.

So, you pull the old Rabid Cultist Two-step: "Won't look! Won't look! Can't look! Can't look!"

No, you're not OK now, and you won't be later.

These mutherfucking psychotic psychopaths aren't just lying. This is "big lie" shit. This is profoundly, radically, opposite-to-any-vestige-of-truth shit.

This is the nature of ALL state violence: create the problem so that you can rush in and "save" everyone -- including not just fomenting wars but defining crimes and creating law enforcement, too.

You all (almost) believe that the military and the justice system are there to protect you. That's a stone-blind belief no less false and baseless than the most bizarre cult dogma. Militaries and "law and order" are the worst cons there have ever been. Protect you? Hell no. They exist to terrify you into permanent states of dread.

They exist to protect the "rich and powerful" from us, because the real truth is: they're pant-shitting terrified of us.

There has never been -- NOT ONCE -- a "just war". Never. Every war that was ever fought was fundamentally and wholly a lie. If parents hadn't been seduced, bewitched, and deluded about the actual nature of the wars they performed human sacrifice of their children to wage, they would have sacrificed themselves to protect their children, not offered them up to Moloch and its fire.

https://substack.com/@mynameisjerm/note/c-74058000
